prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 9 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1138; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness. Over nine visits, care consisted of physical therapy, guided home exercise, and short-term anti-inflammatory medication. The reported symptoms are consistent in nature and location with the mechanism and force of the impact. Early examinations documented reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, supporting the presenting complaints, while neurological screening and reflex testing remained within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body regions is known to this office. The course of care followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as pain and mobility improved. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered without duplication. At the most recent visit the patient reported substantial improvement and was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
